# Coding tools

Coding agents and IDEs that sell their own plan or come with a free quota tied to an account (opencode, Cline, Command Code, Antigravity CLI and others). **BYOK** says whether you can bring your own API key instead, which is how you point a tool at the [router](../router/index.md) or a pay-per-token provider. Account quotas don't go through the router; they're a backup when the router's free quotas run out.
